subject.title: Feature Requests: quota-aware grant pools, live provider quota tracking, and same-provider failover

question: Which remaining quota-aware routing capabilities should ClawRouter support in core next: provider-specific collectors, additional selection modes, or stale-state/failover policy controls?
rationale: The current main implementation intentionally stops at a provider-neutral passive-header and bounded-failover core, while the remaining request changes provider contracts and routing policy.

options.title: Design provider contracts first
options.body: Define manifest/adapter contracts for provider quota collectors and stale-state behavior before adding more routing modes.

options.title: Limit to current core
options.body: Treat the landed provider-neutral passive-header and bounded-failover behavior as sufficient for now and close or split the rest later.

options.title: Add selection modes first
options.body: Implement round-robin, least-used, weighted, or sticky modes before provider-specific collectors, accepting limited quota freshness.

recommendation.title: Design provider contracts first
recommendation.body: Define manifest/adapter contracts for provider quota collectors and stale-state behavior before adding more routing modes.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the landed grant-pool and failover PRs and commented on the deliberately unimplemented remainder.
